scientific_interpretation: Historical 10/520 equity co-crash frequency exceeds independent-marginal product (11/520)*(15/520) by about 1.862 percentage points. The two equity indices overlap economically and share market shocks; do not count those ten events as independent model wins. This is a descriptive historical dependence check useful for model architecture, NOT a retrospective score or a new 2026-11-27 forecast. Weekly 4-block bootstrapped error bars approximate, regime shifts and extreme rarity remain.
real_execution: Used GitHub-stored real 2016-2026 daily asset price series acquired Nov21, built calendar-week last-quote pairs, computed 520 non-overlapping weekly changes and 3000 deterministic 4-week circular block bootstrap resamples with xorshift32; connector-side JavaScript executed; standalone replay source committed. No parameter refit, no forward Monte Carlo scenario run, no live day close scored.
known_limitations: Yahoo history snapshots for equities and FRED DGS10 are retrospective, not certified original vintages; original prospectively sealed forecasts used different source combinations.
Bond quote date differs from equity quote date for four weeks; those remain visible, not silently merged.
Exclude Nov16–20 weekly change from the 520 joint complete weeks because FRED staging stops Nov19, unlike equity quotes Nov20.
